changeSet.author: cold-storage-monitoring-audit
changeSet.comment: The unique constraint/index on freezer.name is unconditional, but FreezerDAOImpl.findByName only checks deleted=false rows - so once a name is soft-deleted, the app thinks it's free to reuse while the DB still rejects the insert with a raw constraint violation, which FreezerMonitoringExceptionHandler does not catch, surfacing as an opaque 500 (GitHub issue #3904). Replace the unconditional unique enforcement with one scoped to non-deleted rows.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE clinlims.freezer DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS freezer_name_key;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_freezer_name_active ON clinlims.freezer (name) WHERE deleted = false;

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS clinlims.idx_freezer_name_active; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_freezer_name ON clinlims.freezer (name);
